name: Kota Keratin Treatment Double Care 250ml Hair Mask Natural Product
description:
Kota Keratin Treatment Double Care 250ml Hair Mask Natural Product 
Helps care for dry and damaged hair from chemicals, colours, straightening, perming and heat. Helps hair come back beautiful, shiny, and weighty. 
For nourishing colored hair, for damaged/split ends, dry skin, weight, and hair loss. 
Helps with the frizziness of the hair. 
How to use: After cleaning the hair Anointing treatment In an appropriate amount, leave to marinate for 20-30 minutes. Then rinse thoroughly with water. Can be used in place of hair conditioner or for hair spa along with steam bath. Or use after chemical, coloring, straightening, bending. Use as often as desired. 
Product of Thailand
